security-mode.name: security-mode
security-mode.help: Port or MAC based 802.1X security mode.

options.name: 802.1X
options.help: 802.1X port based authentication.

options.name: 802.1X-mac-based
options.help: 802.1X MAC based authentication.

user-group.name: user-group
user-group.help: Name of user-group to assign to this MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB) policy.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable MAB.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable MAB.

open-auth.name: open-auth
open-auth.help: Enable/disable open authentication for this policy.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable open authentication.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable open authentication.

eap-passthru.name: eap-passthru
eap-passthru.help: Enable/disable EAP pass-through mode, allowing protocols (such as LLDP) to pass through ports for more flexible authentication.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable EAP pass-through mode on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable EAP pass-through mode on this interface.

eap-auto-untagged-vlans.name: eap-auto-untagged-vlans
eap-auto-untagged-vlans.help: Enable/disable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.

guest-vlan.name: guest-vlan
guest-vlan.help: Enable the guest VLAN feature to allow limited access to non-802.1X-compliant clients.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable guest VLAN on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable guest VLAN on this interface.

auth-fail-vlan.name: auth-fail-vlan
auth-fail-vlan.help: Enable to allow limited access to clients that cannot authenticate.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable authentication fail VLAN on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable authentication fail VLAN on this interface.

auth-fail-vlan-id.name: auth-fail-vlan-id
auth-fail-vlan-id.help: VLAN ID on which authentication failed.

framevid-apply.name: framevid-apply
framevid-apply.help: Enable/disable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN.

radius-timeout-overwrite.name: radius-timeout-overwrite
radius-timeout-overwrite.help: Enable to override the global RADIUS session timeout.

options.name: disable
options.help: Override the global RADIUS session timeout.

options.name: enable
options.help: Use the global RADIUS session timeout.

options.name: 802.1X
options.help: 802.1X security policy.

authserver-timeout-period.name: authserver-timeout-period
authserver-timeout-period.help: Authentication server timeout period (3 - 15 sec, default = 3).

authserver-timeout-vlan.name: authserver-timeout-vlan
authserver-timeout-vlan.help: Enable/disable the authentication server timeout VLAN to allow limited access when RADIUS is unavailable.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable authentication server timeout VLAN on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable authentication server timeout VLAN on this interface.

authserver-timeout-tagged.name: authserver-timeout-tagged
authserver-timeout-tagged.help: Configure timeout option for the tagged VLAN which allows limited access when the authentication server is unavailable.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable authentication server timeout on this interface.

options.name: lldp-voice
options.help: LLDP voice timeout for the tagged VLAN on this interface.

options.name: static
options.help: Static timeout for the tagged VLAN on this interface.

authserver-timeout-tagged-vlanid.name: authserver-timeout-tagged-vlanid
authserver-timeout-tagged-vlanid.help: Tagged VLAN name for which the timeout option is applied to (only one VLAN ID).

dacl.name: dacl
dacl.help: Enable/disable dynamic access control list on this interface.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable dynamic access control list on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable dynamic access control on this interface.
